## Description
Ultra-High-Molecular-Weight Polyethylene (UHMW-PE) is a thermoplastic with extremely &#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;long molecular chains (2–6 million daltons, vs. ~10,000 for standard HDPE).&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;It has wear resistance: 10× better than carbon steel.&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;a 25 mm thick 1m x 1m with density of 0.93 g/cm3 is 23.3 kg&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;&#9;https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ultra-high-molecular-weight_polyethylene&#10;&#9;&#9;
